monito.name: Monito del Monte
monito.fact: Unique marsupial from the Valdivian forests. Considered a living fossil.

araucaria.name: Araucaria Araucana
araucaria.fact: Ancient tree sacred to the Mapuche people. Its seeds (piñones) are ancestral food.

woodpecker.name: Magellanic Woodpecker
woodpecker.fact: The largest woodpecker in South America. Inhabits native forests of Chile and Argentina.

frog.name: Darwin's Frog
frog.fact: Endemic species that incubates its young in its mouth. Endangered.

fern.name: Giant Fern
fern.fact: Found in both Valdivian and Amazon rainforests. Can reach 5 meters tall.

orchid.name: Native Orchid
orchid.fact: Over 3,000 species in LATAM rainforests. An indicator of ecosystem health.
